sources.identifier: Intersalt Cooperative Research Group. BMJ 1988;297:319-328. DOI 10.1136/bmj.297.6644.319
sources.population: 10079 participants aged 20-59 from 52 centres in 32 countries; community/workforce selection; antihypertensive use retained.
sources.measurement: Mean of two seated Hawksley random-zero readings after five-minute rest; height and weight measured twice. Original pp319-320.

sources.identifier: Zhang et al. J Clin Hypertens 2022;24:825-837. DOI 10.1111/jch.14529
sources.population: 1257 Beijing community participants in 2009 selected after exclusion of prior MI, stroke, severe CHF, blood-sample refusal and missing information; antihypertensive therapy retained. Exact age range not verified.
sources.measurement: Seated non-dominant arm Omron HEM-4021 after five-minute rest; mean of two measurements within two minutes. Methods 2-2.2.

items.locator: Table II p322, body mass index column, pooled regression coefficient and SE, SBP
items.selection: Within-centre regressions, adults 20-59, all 52 centres; pooled by inverse variance.
items.applicability: Reported coefficient per one kg/m^2; richer adjustment and inverse-variance pooling differ from requested age/sex-only weighted target association. Source SE is estimator precision, not transport uncertainty.
